dynamics_prior.architecture: causal Transformer adapted from span_transformer v2; freshly initialized, no imported v2 weights
dynamics_prior.inputs: same bounded 16-segment own history; 256-segment extension is a separate experiment
dynamics_prior.targets: direct Flash/Pro current focus events6/modes6/any-event; prediction computed exclusively from past own outputs and detached past focus representations
dynamics_prior.time_coordinate: segment order; no future duration or full trace length

own_history.history_source: own latest probabilities available before current step; detached; no teacher forcing
own_history.revision_schedule: every past eligible consecutive focus, age1..16, once per new segment
own_history.training_order: shuffle traces per epoch seed+epoch, ascending sid within trace

scope: Fresh Qwen3-4B LoRA plus causal dynamics Transformer trained jointly; own-history and append-only revisions; direct Flash/Pro only
selection: fixed final checkpoint after one complete epoch; validation only for thresholds; no test selection
